source.author: ov
source.text: Perque aera vento ad iussam delata domum est et protinus intrat sacrilegi thalamos altoque sopore solutum noctis enim tempus geminis amplectitur ulnis: seque viro inspirat faucesque et pectus et ora afflat et in vacuis spargit ieiunia venis.
source.text_original: Perque aera vento / ad iussam delata domum est et protinus intrat / sacrilegi thalamos altoque sopore solutum / (noctis enim tempus) geminis amplectitur ulnis: / seque viro inspirat faucesque et pectus et ora / afflat et in vacuis spargit ieiunia venis.
source.text_english: And through the air, borne by the wind, she came to the home she had been bidden to, and straightway enters the impious man’s chamber; for it is night’s time, and deep sleep has loosed him, as night enfolds all in twin arms: she breathes herself into the man and breathes upon his throat and chest and face, and spreads fasting through his empty veins.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: qua iussos sed tandem quaerere Colchos arte queat?
reuse.text_original: qua iussos sed tandem quaerere Colchos / arte queat?
reuse.text_english: By what means could he at last seek out the Colchians, since he was ordered?
